records.name: Acadia National Park
records.description: Major coastal Nature Highlight around Mount Desert Island and nearby peninsulas.

evidence.travelerAppeal: national park, rocky coast, mountains, carriage roads, ocean views

records.name: Cadillac Mountain
records.description: High-elevation Acadia destination with broad views over Mount Desert Island and the Atlantic.

evidence.travelerAppeal: summit views, sunrise, signature Acadia landscape

records.name: Jordan Pond
records.description: Clear glacial pond and classic Acadia landscape below the Bubbles.

evidence.travelerAppeal: pond views, hiking access, iconic Acadia scenery

records.description: Signature Acadia Scenic Segment connecting ocean, forest, mountain, and lake views.

evidence.travelerAppeal: scenic drive, ocean overlooks, access to major Acadia stops

records.name: Thunder Hole

records.name: Sand Beach
records.description: Small ocean beach between rocky headlands on the east side of Mount Desert Island.

evidence.travelerAppeal: beach, cliffs, ocean access, Park Loop Road stop

records.name: Otter Cliff
records.description: Prominent sea cliff and coastal Landmark along Acadia's ocean drive.

evidence.travelerAppeal: sea cliffs, ocean views, photography, climbing context

records.name: Bass Harbor Head Light Station
records.description: Historic lighthouse Landmark on the southwestern side of Mount Desert Island.

records.name: Schoodic Peninsula
records.description: Quieter mainland section of Acadia with rocky coast, ocean views, and scenic driving.

evidence.travelerAppeal: rocky coast, quieter Acadia experience, scenic drive
